free_tier.stated: No free tier and no free trial; '30 Days Risk Free' on every plan is a money-back guarantee.

per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: The vendor states 'Exceptional Binary and Text Retention' and 'Binary Retention!' with no day count on either page read. The r/usenet map records a 3,000-day backfill; that third-party figure is the only number available.

egress.terms: Unlimited, with 50 connections included and an upgrade path to 150

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Direct access buys the 150-connection upgrade no reseller sells, and the 500 GB block stacks as a fill under any other primary.

limits.value: 3,000-day backfill, reported by the r/usenet map; not stated by the vendor

limits_note: Monthly $10, 6 months $50, yearly $90 (USD 7.50/mo equivalent), block 500 GB $20. All unlimited plans include free headers, free posting, header compression and a VPN account.
binding_note: Unlimited volume and speed; the vendor publishes no fair-use figure, so nothing in the vocabulary binds at 1 TiB/month.

identity_cost.detail: Email plus a paid plan. No trial exists. The vendor states accounts are provisioned after payment

reliability_note: Own Tier-1 backbone with US and NL farms, AS62296 in the US and AS50673 in Amsterdam. Sells to resellers (NewsDemon, NewsgroupDirect, CubeNet, ThunderNews, UsenetPrime, UsenetNews) and directly.
confidence_note: Prices and connections are from the vendor's plans page read. Retention is not stated by the vendor anywhere read, so the r/usenet backfill figure is used and the record drops to the reported rung because retention decides the retrieval verdict.

evidence.proved: Monthly unlimited $10; 6 months $50; yearly $90; 500 GB block $20; 50 connections; 256-bit SSL; 30 days risk free
'$7.50/mth subscribe yearly and save'; 'Exceptional Binary and Text Retention'; 50 SSL connections; VPN account included
backbone table records UsenetExpress US full spool, NL cached, 'Backfill: 3000 days'

notes: Second independent backbone after Omicron by retention depth, and the only one whose resellers publish blocks under $50/TB.
